chunks: Will eat of the tree of Zaqqum

key_terms.زَقُّومٍ: A specific tree in Hell known for its bitter fruit

ai.seo_question: What is the Zaqqum tree and who eats from it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the Zaqqum tree is often interpreted not merely as a physical entity but as a manifestation of the disbelievers' own evil deeds, reflecting the principle of 'action returning to the actor.' This verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan underscores the tangible reality of Hellfire, where the bitter taste of the tree symbolizes the spiritual bitterness of rejecting divine truth.
